items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: And then, we had drummers... Now, that's Brother Joe Welles, he could read drum music. Yeah, he was a good little drummer. We had very few drummers that could read music.

ctx.x: You're a drummer. You should ask him some questions about drumming.

And, uh, at a tune, the snare would have the proper tone, and the bass drum would get the proper tone. Cause, cause he'd run it up. And it would, it would be sharp or flat. He could tune it up, you see, until he'd get to the right pitch. And then, we had drummers, we had very few drummers at that time that could read music. Mm-hmm.
